voiceScript: A personal laptop can quietly carry customer data outside your business. Small Business BYOD means employees using their own phones or computers for work, mixing company information with personal apps and family use. Picture this: an employee downloads a customer spreadsheet to a personal laptop with no screen lock. Here is why that matters: a lost, shared, or infected device can carry company data outside the business. Set minimum device rules before allowing personal devices. Keep work data in managed apps and remove access when employment ends. Click the Follow button to see new cybersecurity tips every day.
